name: Lajin Entertainment Network Group Limited
summary: Lajin Entertainment Network Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides movies, TV program, and internet content services in Mainland China. It operates in three segments: Artiste Management Service, New Media E-Commerce and Movies, and TV Programmes and Internet Contents Services. The company invests in, produces, and distributes movies and TV programs; invests in internet content; provides artiste management services; and promotes and demonstrates through live video on the website, as well as engages in digital technology business. It also engages in the business of cultural and entertainment media content, as well as sourcing and production of media content. The company was formerly known as China Star Cultural Media Group Limited and changed its name to Lajin Entertainment Network Group Limited in August 2015. Lajin Entertainment Network Group Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
